terms.grammar: ordinal adjective, first and second declension
terms.comment: Nōngentī as Traupman writes it, with the long vowel of nōnus; Lewis & Short leaves it unmarked (also nōningentī, Col.).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
